```{=html}
<div class="mlsp-game-container" role="region" aria-label="Roofline Rider mini-game">
  <canvas id="mlsp-canvas" class="mlsp-game-canvas" width="680" height="460"></canvas>
  <div class="mlsp-game-hud">
    <span class="mlsp-score">health <span id="mlsp-health">100</span> · score <span id="mlsp-score">0</span> · <span id="mlsp-phase">memory bound</span></span>
    <span><kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> or touch · dodge stalls · <kbd>R</kbd> retry</span>
    <button type="button" class="mlsp-retry-btn" onclick="window.location.reload()">Retry</button>
    <button type="button" class="mlsp-fullscreen-btn" onclick="this.closest('.mlsp-game-container').requestFullscreen()" title="Full Screen" aria-label="Full Screen">⛶</button>
  </div>
  <div class="mlsp-touch-controls" aria-label="Kernel steering controls">
    <button type="button" class="mlsp-train-control mlsp-steer-control" data-steer="up">↑ Up</button>
    <button type="button" class="mlsp-train-control mlsp-steer-control" data-steer="down">↓ Down</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="mlsp-aha-slot"></div>

<script>
(function bootRoofline(){
  function tryBoot() {
    if (!window.MLSP || !MLSP.games || !MLSP.games.roofline) return setTimeout(tryBoot, 30);
    var canvas = document.getElementById("mlsp-canvas");
    var $score = document.getElementById("mlsp-score");
    var $health = document.getElementById("mlsp-health");
    var $phase = document.getElementById("mlsp-phase");
    var ahaSlot = document.getElementById("mlsp-aha-slot");
    var pendingResult = null;
    var resolvedApi = null;

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') window.location.reload();
    });

    Promise.resolve(MLSP.games.roofline(canvas, {
      onScoreChange: function(s) { $score.textContent = s.score; $health.textContent = s.health; $phase.textContent = s.phase; },
      onGameOver: function(result) {
        if (resolvedApi) attachAha(resolvedApi, result);
        else pendingResult = result;
      },
      onRetry: function() { window.location.reload(); }
    })).then(function(api) {
      resolvedApi = api;
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-steer]').forEach(function(button) {
        var direction = button.dataset.steer;
        button.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); button.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); api.steer(direction, true); });
        ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture'].forEach(function(type) {
          button.addEventListener(type, function() { api.steer(direction, false); });
        });
      });
      if (pendingResult) attachAha(api, pendingResult);
    });

    function attachAha(api, result) {
      MLSP.showAhaCard(ahaSlot, api.ahaLabel, api.ahaText, api.ahaLink);
    }
  }
  tryBoot();
})();
</script>
```

## How to play
Your glowing kernel moves right as operational intensity increases. Press `Up` or `Down`, or hold the on-screen buttons, to steer performance toward the cyan Roofline. The sloped section is memory bound; the flat section is compute bound. Staying close to the roof earns points. Dodge orange stalls and reach the finish line. Touching the roof or a stall costs health.

## The Systems Concept
The Roofline model shows two hardware limits. Increasing operational intensity can raise attainable performance while memory bandwidth sets the ceiling. Once the line flattens, peak compute sets the ceiling and more intensity alone no longer raises that limit. This is an arcade metaphor; real kernels do not physically collide with the line.
